loading.where: Calendar: text under the spinner while the month's data loads

previousMonth.where: Calendar header: screen-reader label of the back arrow

nextMonth.where: Calendar header: screen-reader label of the forward arrow

legendFullyStaffed.where: Calendar legend (planning mode): green dot, the service has enough confirmed musicians

legendNeedsAttention.where: Calendar legend (planning mode): amber dot, some musicians unconfirmed or missing

legendNoMusicians.where: Calendar legend (planning mode): red dot, nobody scheduled

noAssignments.where: Calendar day cell (planning mode): under a setlist when no musician is scheduled

createShabbatMorning.where: Calendar day cell: small button on an empty Saturday that starts a Shabbat-morning setlist
createShabbatMorning.context: Shabbat = the Jewish sabbath; AM = morning service

createFridayEvening.where: Calendar day cell: small button on an empty Friday that starts a Friday-evening setlist
